notes.title: Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉
notes.content:
[h3]Get your survival skills ready - Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello Elvels! 

We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Frost Survival VR [/b]has just launched on Steam! 

Frost Survival VR is a sandbox survival set in a frozen wilderness. Face a frozen wilderness solo or in co-op - build a shelter, craft tools, hunt for food, and manage your resources to endure harsh conditions. Strategize your moves against unpredictable weather and lurking dangers. And remember to keep yourself safe and sane![/p][p][/p][h3]Play the game now![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054950/Frost_Survival_VR/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We encourage you to join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/wenklystudio"]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wenklystudio"]TikTok[/url], X and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/FrostSurvivalVR/"]Reddit[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Needs & Survival 🏹[/b][/h3][p]Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wits and limited resources to survive harsh conditions in this [b]Sandbox Survival. [/b]Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?[/p][p][b]Build your Base[/b]: Build a shelter to escape the frost and replenish vital strengths.[/p][p][b]Tools & Weapons[/b]: To survive and fully exploit your surroundings, you will need a variety of tools.[/p][p][b]Hunt, Craft & Gather[/b]: Hunt wild animals to gain food and resources.[/p][h3][b]Winter & Wilderness❄️[/b][/h3][p]Surviving isn't easy. Strategizing your moves is crucial to staying alive. Complete essential tasks during daylight and be aware of the darkness, as nighttime brings [b]lower temperatures[/b]. [b]Weather conditions[/b] are unpredictable and change dynamically, so always be prepared!  Explore a [b]huge map[/b], but remember that not every place is safe; some may be inaccessible based on your current gear.[/p][h3][b]Safe & Sane 👾[/b][/h3][p]Survival isn’t just about staying alive; it’s also about [b]staying sane[/b]. How do you keep your humanity in this frozen hell?[/p][p]In Frost Survival VR, you must take care of not only your physiological needs, such as hunger, thirst, and keeping yourself warm, but also your [b]mental health[/b]. If you neglect it, reality may start to blur with illusion. [b]Fake sounds[/b] and [b]creatures[/b] will make survival even more challenging. But beware - some figments of your imagination can harm you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer Experience👥[/b][/h3][p]Try to survive [b]alone[/b] or [b]cooperate[/b] with others in a multiplayer experience.[/p][p]Do you like playing alone? Don’t worry, there are some uncovered secrets scattered across the frozen wilderness that will help you endure. Or you can work together with other players: gather resources, insulate your shelter, and defend against threats like cold, hunger, and dangerous animals. [b]Shape your survival sandbox experience your way![/b][/p][p][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/shared/images/responsive/youtube_16x9_placeholder.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Astro Hunters VR releases on August 8th!👨‍🚀
notes.content:
[h2]Astro Hunters VR is set to launch August 8th!👨‍🚀[/h2]

Hello Elves!

We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Astro Hunters VR[/b] launches on Steam on [b] August 8th at 7PM CEST[/b]! 🌌🎮

Astro Hunters VR is a [b]PvPvE Extraction Shooter[/b] set in space. Immerse yourself in the exploration of a unique planet, fight with different enemies, craft, gather resources, and upgrade your weapons. 
Become one of the mercenaries and help the Mothership. We’re waiting for you! But remember there are also other hunters on the planet. Will you ally, fight, or betray - it's up to you!🚀

To celebrate the launch, we have some fantastic offer for early supporters:
👨‍🚀-10% Discount👨‍🚀 

🔔Add the game to your wishlist to get notified once the game is out: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=Vh1uVNN-OzA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🚀The Hunt Begins[/h3]
Undertake dangerous missions and challenge other players and in exchange freely scavenge the planets. You can join forces with other players, but be careful, hunting down other players to seize their valuable equipment is also an option! Going on an expedition comes with a high reward if you find valuable items, but it’s also high risk - if you die, you lose everything!

[h3]🔨Gather Resources and Craft[/h3]
Collect resources such as gases, liquids, metals, and others on different planets. Each of the resources has its special gathering tool. Use the collected items to craft new and better equipment. The Mothership provides you with crafting stations, on which you can craft inhalers, weapon parts, ammo and more. Do you want to store them, sell for good money, or trade with other players? The choice is yours!

[h3]🔫Manage and Upgrade your Equipment[/h3]
Gather a diverse range of weapons: pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, machine guns, shotguns, and snipers. Upgrade stats and customize them with elemental modifications: fire, plasma, electricity, and acid. Beware of other players lurking on the planets for your loot. To avoid being left with nothing, store some of them in your storage room to be ready for your next expedition.

✍️We are looking forward to your reviews and feedback. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

Join our amazing community in our [url=discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/AstroHuntersVR]X[/url] to share your experience and get to know Hunters

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 1.5.0 is ready for download.
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, elves! [/h2]
I have some amazing news for you! It's time for a new update! 
This time we have a lot of much-awaited changes and a few surprises for you. 

[h1]Escort the dwarves[/h1]
Orcs have invaded the dwarves' mine. 
Protect a group of dwarves and help them get to the exit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/ab5610bf91f2fbdc7967b8a389e17a6d3ac3bd7f.jpg[/img]


[h1]Escort the carriage[/h1]
The elf princess has to return from the village to the castle. Help her on her way home before the orcs get her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/9b2ba0680b7f2a2411e0b8d054d09fdd13a62f93.jpg[/img]

[h1]Exploding Orc[/h1]
Along with the new maps, a new enemy has also appeared. The Exploding Orc. Shoot his barrel to blow him up before he blows up everything else. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/4ac25bb2a16703b8ab731775406b22c92a716171.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment statistics[/h1]
From now on, the choice of equipment will have an impact on gameplay! Gear will provide additional statistics and choosing the bow won't just be a cosmetic decision!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/727a3d90603b23dd674cc348ff3a99465f60a0c4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rapid-fire[/h1]
Speaking of bows, we have noticed that some of you are not happy with the ability to shoot at high speed. We decided to come out ahead and added the ability to choose if rapid-fire will be available on the server. Now each of you will be able to decide if you want this technique in your game or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/0b6fafc2dfa8cdb2eb3eaee272f05f3fb46c7063.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rebalanced difficulty[/h1]
We noticed that the game gets harder very slowly, so we decided to increase the difficulty level on later waves without affecting the initial ones. On top of that, we've added two new units that can take a lot of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/d0df72655a771cf2a7bb6e740cf190dd7a830002.png[/img]

[h1]Skip initial waves[/h1]
If you want to jump right into the battle without having to fight the first waves, then this option is for you. With Skip Initial Waves, you will start the game right from wave 30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/3cd34f3358dfb9fe02274d14fb020828ed65e4ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pause system[/h1]
Now it is time for the long-awaited change. We are adding the possibility to vote for the start of a pause, and we are shortening the waiting time between waves. This way you will be able to take longer pauses when you need to, not when the game tells you to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/b837dcd4aa34eb35a3ba8e8804951bfa7307239e.jpg[/img]

Let us know what you think of all the new features we have prepared for you! 
Also check out our Facebook group: 
https://www.facebook.com/groups/elvenassassin
And the Discord server:
https://www.discord.gg/elvenassassin

notes.title: Update 1.4.2 is now available to download!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Elves![/h2]
The new update is now available, and in it we have something really big for you.
Get your bows ready, because there will be many things to shoot at.

[h1]Winter PvP map (up to 8 players)[/h1]
Welcome the new winter PvP map up to 8 players! Now you can bring even more friends together and fight each other to the death! Be careful, because the map is really big, so you can get hit from many different places!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/1d18f2d6852943a1bb9041279fa75342a7d16cb8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Defend bay![/h1]
In addition to the new PvP map, starting today you will also have to defend the bay, as the Orcs have decided to come from the other side of the ocean. Get ready to sink ships and fend off the waves of enemies! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/0b0eb733c5b91f28d8d3e06f37b418f881573684.jpg[/img]

[h1]New orcs![/h1]
Since the Orcs have travelled such a long distance, they have also decided to recruit new units. Look out for three new types of orcs. Each of them is just as dangerous as the previous ones. However, do not underestimate them, because there's strength in numbers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26263879/0619e972f2bd805ad2861414a50aa0705e4c7427.jpg[/img]

[h3]In addition to the new maps and orcs, we also added a few nice features:[/h3]
[h2]Snap turn[/h2]
The first feature is "Snap turn", which is the ability to rotate on the platform using the controller stick. You can enable this feature in the settings, as it is disabled by default. 

[h2]Mute players[/h2]
Another feature is the ability to mute other players in the game. You can do this by clicking the microphone on the scoreboard. But remember, just because you can't hear him, it doesn't mean that he can't hear you ;). 

[h2]Roaring dragon[/h2]
Another change is the roaring dragon. When a dragon wave comes, the dragon will make a powerful roar to let you know that he is coming. Now you will be better prepared for his arrival. 

[h2]Discord Server[/h2]
The last change is the icon of our Discord server in the settings. If you want to join the server and chat with others, this is the best way to do it. 

[h3]A note to the previous update:[/h3]
Recently you have been asking a lot about the "Password cooldown feature" because we haven't fully explained what it is. "Password cooldown" is a new feature to prevent unwanted players from joining the game. Previously, you could guess the password to a private lobby over and over until you succeeded. Now with each incorrectly entered password, the user will have to wait a few seconds to enter the password again. This should discourage some players from breaking into private games. 

We hope you enjoy the new update. 
Feel free to join our Facebook group and give us your feedback. https://www.facebook.com/groups/elvenassassin
Also, you can check our Discord:
https://www.discord.gg/elvenassassin

notes.title: Update 1.19 - Private rooms
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Assassins![/h1]

This update brings you the long requested feature which allows you to create private rooms. With this, you will no longer have to worry about random people joining your game, allowing your elite squad to shoot orcs in peace. 

Whenever you do want to meet new friends just leave the game public as a sign of invitation!

Here’s a quick rundown on how it works:

[h1] Personal Version[/h1]

While creating a room, you get an option to set it private.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/01f071132d47cae5a910254d06c6dd27ec78e8ef.png[/img] 

If you do, clicking Create will take you to a window which allows you to set a passcode for it. Make one up and share it with your friends.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/87a05b6b469f1a5a09cc27f65277f7930365a572.png[/img]

Other players will see that this room is private, and will be prompted to type in the passcode upon clicking Join. If the passcode is correct, they’ll be allowed to enter. Otherwise, the game doesn’t let them in. Simple as that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/218564b64b8c13c16a0d71b9ac111b50bf798f7a.png[/img]

[h1] Arcade Version [/h1]

VR Park owners, on the other hand, can set up a whole private server. 
In Arcade Settings, found in the Settings window, you can opt in to use a local server. This option persist between launches, so you only have to configure it once. 

[olist]
    [*]Clicking “Setup->Create” generates a code which identifies your server.
    [*]To enable your other machines to join this server, select the “Local” option on them as well, and use “Setup->Join” to join the server. 
    [*]You’ll be prompted to input the server code, which was generated on your first machine.
[/olist]

Here is the diagram which graphically shows how to set this up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/3cfe43481d5b613b692b88f47586e656f1a8b241.png[/img]
You can even set up multiple servers for your Park, say you have 8 machines with Elven Assassin running and you want to group them into two groups of 4 so that players from one group don’t join players from the other by accident - simply generate two server codes and assign one to first 4 machines, and the other code to the remaining 4.

With that we figured the VR Park version doesn’t need the private room option so that your players can play the game without doing an additional step, but if you think you need private rooms after all, do tell us.

Also, we introduced an option to choose "default region" which shortens multiplayer game creation process in your Arcade, as it does not show the screen with region selection.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

We have also pushed some bugfixes, most notably:
[olist]
    [*] Fixed rare cases where other players arrows would behave strangely when the other player draws their arrow
    [*]Deathmatch: Fixed players sometimes getting teleported back to the platform they just died on shortly after respawning
    [*]Fixed Player Titles not distinguishing between players with the same Steam name
    [*]When teleporting, players using Rift in the Steam version of the game will now be rotated towards the center of action instead of the general direction they were looking at before teleporting
   [*]Fixed camera blinking when changing scenes that players using Rift experienced
[/olist]

[h1]Patch 1.19.2[/h1] 
Fix problems with loading lobby that happened for some players.

[h1] Stay tunned as the new updates are being worked on![/h1]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/cace6b57773e51b638d6ed58d629899b6ca0ea44.png[/img]

Today we have something very exciting for you. 

[h1] PVP Deathmatch mode [/h1]
This is something that we have been developing for a long time and now want to push it for you to try it. We think it is a great refreshment to the game and we had tons of fun testing it. 

Before every serious battle, Elven Assassins like to train their archery skills and reflex, so they challenge each other in the Old Ruins Garden. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/f620e3de163e769b7210835da666b3c531eb0ec8.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
The game match is 7 minutes long and the goal for every player is to get as many 'kills' per round as possible (probably everyone knows what deathmatch is ;)) Let us know if 7 min is just right or if you would want it more/less.

Mind that the aiming might be challenging as player representation (helmet and torso) is much harder to hit than big orcs. Especially when the opponent is constantly moving or clipping from behind the wall. 

The new thing that we had to implement is that once the spot is taken by one player, other players cannot teleport to this spot. After the player leaves the certain teleport spot, it becomes available for teleport after few seconds.

[h1]Killstreak[/h1]
Having scored many hits in a row without getting hit yourself will give your bow some cool effects.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/8250fedf6525c30ddbfc33e3d1dec79a940ba42e.png[/img]

[h1]Map[/h1]
Old Ruins Garden is the place that Elven Assassins train their skills. The map consists of 16 teleport spots to which you can teleport, we have adjusted them in a way that it enables few gameplay approaches. You can play like scout and hide in one place just waiting for your opponents to appear or go with more dynamic approach teleporting and misleading your opponents of where you are.

[h1]Aditional Scoreboard[/h1]
We have added additional scoreboard as sometimes you want to check the score and time fast so now you don't have to open the menu window. It can be accessed by holding [b]trigger[/b] on your bow-hand.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/db03f9721f0aceeda8e12f085f063973aa25c4b4.png[/img]

[h1]Platforms' numbers and feedback[/h1]
As the map is still in development stage we have created the indication of platform number for you so if you have any feedback concerning gameplay or for example, if you happen to notice that some colliders don't match with the mesh correctly don't hesitate to let us know and we will try to fix it as soon as possible.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/2d90abe18fe1fed10e4808d64d8da3d8a542e940.png[/img]

Here is the link to discussion thread if you like to share some thoughts about the mode:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/503770/discussions/0/1696040635907832924/

notes.title: Update 1.17 - Titles
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/145133f9cc320be05ae76e0501bedc85f6cd75e5.png[/img]

Hi there Elven Assassins.

A lot of new things today so let's just get right into it.

[h1]Player Titles[/h1]
This is something that we thought you might like. If the player played some important role during the game he/she will be honored with one or few of following titles:
[olist]
[*][b]The Swift[/b] - The player that dodged the most flying axes during the game.
[*][b]The Sniper[/b]  - The player that shot the most long-distant headshots.
[*][b]The Skilled[/b]  - The player that had the best shot accuracy during the game.
[*][b]The Vigilant[/b]  - The player that killed most enemies close to the castle gate and by it saved the wave.
[*][b]The Sky Guardian[/b]  - The Player that killed most airborne enemies (Wyverns, Dragons).
[*][b]The Wizard[/b]  - The Player that dealt most damage to the enemies by using magical spells.
[*][b]The Butcher[/b]  - The player that dealt most overall damage to the enemies.
[*][b]The Slayer[/b]  - The player that dealt most damage to boss type enemies like (Trolls, Dragons)
[/olist]
Player Titles are visible after the multiplayer game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/e2b52d5f1ecfbc78f1e739e39bcd5bbd89e71f83.png[/img]

[h1]New middle platform on Elven Town[/h1]
As the middle platform was much overpowered and the player standing on it always had the best score, we have decided to improve it in a way that now it consists 2 teleport spots that you can move around or guard the Town with two players on it, one covering the front and one covering the back. We have also added some interactive elements to Elven Town.

[h1]1.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/244f0c1a45af92a366bc315a42ee3586c33e692b.png[/img]

[h1]2.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/37d9a3f8d1fa5210b702fa6f0d2a3f0329df9365.png[/img]

[h1]Graphical Improvements on Human Castle[/h1]
We have decided to improve the overall graphics of Human Castle.

[h1]1.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/5824913fd574a8a1d8be25189391293cf10f57a5.png[/img]

[h1]2.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/2168d5c241215b0def51a5bd304474dfa36ca86d.png[/img]

[h1]Major Network optimization[/h1]
We have been investigating some connection issues and manage to optimize the network usage by quite a lot, the network usage has been decreased by ~85% so it should solve some occasional problems with getting lost connection.

[h1] New Dragon Boss [/h1]
We have added new dragon boss to increase the difficulty for those that reach very high waves. This dragon is much stronger than previous ones, the one Fire Explosion might no longer be sufficient to defeat it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/145133f9cc320be05ae76e0501bedc85f6cd75e5.png[/img]

[h1]Others[/h1]
- Now Ancient Temple location is also available in the single-player game.

[h1]Price increase[/h1]
As following Early Access information the game now will be priced 15$ to reflect added value to the game and also appreciate all players that trusted us and supported the game in early stages of development.

Here is the development road map since last price increase:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/2b28550ba3bd07bac605a002b43522f57d5951c6.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/d02685c710c8f46e870c96efc8d4e333ec3621b0.png[/img]

In next announcement, we have something exciting for you so stay tuned.

notes.title: Update 1.15.0 - Human Village
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/f9ef95a079df889694e663903774d8416ee2d2bf.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/686a4413106d993c0fed622ac8835dfbf84e4dbb.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Human Village[/h1]
We are so glad that we can present you what we’ve been working for quite a long time. 
In the Human Village location, you are tasked with preventing orcs from getting into the Upper Town where the villagers took shelter.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
The location heavily benefits from the long process of researching & improving the graphic quality without sacrificing performance of our game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/f9ef95a079df889694e663903774d8416ee2d2bf.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Living Environment[/h1]
To increase your immersion in the world of elven assassin we've pushed a living breath into the surroundings. The new high-quality bushes, trees & grass reacts to the blows of wind. The strong stream current drives the watermill. In the meantime, the lazy smoke is getting out of the chimney in one of the huts.

[h1]New surprising interactions.[/h1]
We really wanted to achieve that you can feel you are part of this fantasy world so we've added some realistic-like interactions that might convince you about that. Hopefully, they will be a little surprising & unexpected. We don't want to spoil the surprise so we are not listing them inside this paragraph. Take a bow and find them by yourself.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/a9f377f2b4fdf9b2adf1618802cf2c705e99fdc1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sounds[/h1] 
We also improved the sounds on the map with the new music and ambient sounds that better fits the climate of the map.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
As for the gameplay, we have designed this location so that it should be not too hard for the new players but still challenging to best archers at higher waves. For the first time, we made use of our new pathfinding system in which each orc follows a little different path than the one running behind him.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/4365193ffb79719d30c97400de40dea0a59ff409.jpg[/img]

[h1]Others[/h1]
New interactable elements on Human Castle. 
Wyverns number scale according to number of players [Requested by community]
Increase the size of the explosion spell [Requested by community]

Tell us what you think either in game reviews or in the discussions. 
Stay tuned for the new update.

New interactable elements on Human Castle. 
Wyverns number scale according to number of players [Requested by community]

Next changes rolling out today. The Update includes two main things. 

[h1]Voting System[/h1] 
This feature allows you to vote on whether the team should stay on the current map or change location without having to leave the game and hoping all players will join.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/4391c822b3f9392ef6ce8ae1cfb60ce9fda29d44.png[/img]

[h1]Spells on Singleplayer[/h1] 
Now you can gain experience and use spells also in Singleplayer mode. This change was strongly requested by the community. To achieve that, we decided to divide Singleplayer into two modes (RPG-with spells & Arcade -without). This way the players that did not unlock powerful spells yet, can compete in “No spells mode” while experienced players can see whether their character will allow them to beat other well trained Elven Assassins.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/88fbcebdffb7bbff3c478e4fb952613f65da7132.png[/img]

[h1]Improved arrow attaching precision[/h1]
Before this update arrows that hit environment elements like wooden barriers might incorrectly attach above the element. We managed to increase this precision greatly. Below you can find images for better understanding the problem.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/be5176a39f3d6c9c180d5bfd19dc58a0c91fa2de.png[/img]

We have improved the castle. Before it looked too flat so we decided to change its architecture a little bit and opened a few windows for the more realistic look. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/466f5ff6ab61b26486a876d2491d014d34b296d8.jpg[/img]

8. Fixed bug when 10 arrows were spawned on joining the game [Requested by community]
9. Fixed the same level displayed for all players before the game starts
10. Fixed voice chat checkbox not working correctly [Requested by community]

[h1] Update 1.0.13 goes live too! [/h1]
PS. Besides the changes described above, the features from Update 1.0.13 leaves beta and becomes live. Read more here :
http://steamcommunity.com/games/503770/announcements/detail/1273802170605263584

notes.title: Update 1.0.13 - Difficulty adjustments & Elite Orc Warriors & Shorter breaks
notes.content:
[h1]Next waves configuration[/h1]
Previously the game was designed to be over around wave 40. We have underestimated some players that reach far more than that. In such case, the 40th wave enemies were spawned in the further waves.  That’s why we have configured the waves 41-60 to be more difficult than the 40.

[h1] Adjust the time between the breaks.[/h1]
The brakes time were likely to long in the further waves, so we’ve made them shorter.

[h1]Elite Orc Warriors[/h1]
The update also includes new Elite Orc Warrior - you will recognize him as he is much larger than normal Orc Warriors and also harder to kill, good luck when you see him :) 
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26263879/ba5e43d738d4b49763d8cce40188902c4537594b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Further development[/h1]
This update does not represent the amount of work we have done since the last update. The new scenarios are being worked on so stay tuned. Before they come we will likely add spells to SinglePlayer and the system that will allow you to change scenario after the games without leaving to the main menu.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 - No lags + better gameplay & graphics
notes.content:
[h1]
When you find any issues please report this in the discussions, and we will try our best to fix it right away. The development of the game is active and we are continuously improving it following the advice of the community for which we are very grateful. 
[/h1]

[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
[olist]
    [*] [b]The previous system of moving orcs was recreated from scratch, to achieve much better performance.[/b] This took us quite a lot of time and introduced many new bugs which (hopefully all) have already been found and fixed. What's the most important, there won't be any lagging orcs anymore! 
    [*] The arrow's trail renderers now match the color of the player.
    [*] Orc footsteps sound now finishes just after the orc is dead. 
    [*] Add dust particles after the orc is dead. 
    [*] Fixed bug when the master was pausing the orcs for others while being in the Vive menu.
    [*] Fixed bug when the player could cheat a time penalty after he/she was killed by the axe (by opening the menu).
    [*] Improved Oculus Touch support.
[/olist]

[h1]Main Menu: [/h1]
[olist]
 [*] Improved lights and shadows quality 
 [*] Items on the table were reorganized for better accessibility
 [*] Spells teleport platform position was adjusted for better accessibility of items
 [*] The mass of the items on the table was adjusted so the interaction is more realistic.
 [*] Impact sounds were added to the items on the table
 [*] Fixed a bug with spells buttons working even if they were not visible
 [*] Added tutorial when you haven’t learned a spell yet and have a spare Spell Points
 [*] The image of the map type is displayed in the lobby
 [*] Fix the "stuck in the main menu" bug
[/olist]

[h1] Elven Town [/h1]
[olist]
 [*] Improved texture's quality of the platform floors
 [*] [b] Terrain changed to a custom mesh.[/b] This significantly reduces the number of draw calls sent to GPU and thus improves the overall performance.
 [*] [b]Changed the terrain texture so that the map looks much better.[/b] 
 [*] [b]The path of the dragon was adjusted for a better gameplay. Now you can shoot it comfortably.[/b]
 [*] The speed of the dragon was decreased when it is near the players. Now it's more likely you will be able to kill it before it burns you.
 [*] The environment near the far elven house was improved.
 [*][b] Anisotropic filtering was used on textures - this improves the quality of the textures.[/b]
[/olist]

[h1]Human Castle[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]First part of changes on castle map making the gameplay better.[/b] There was too little visibility of the orcs on this location and the gameplay was very chaotic. We have changed the archery platforms positions. This also gives a possibility of  performing long distance shoots. We are now looking for the suitable place for the ballista. :)
[*] Big optimization on the castle map. 
[/olist]


[h1]Any feedback appreciated![/h1]

notes.title: 1.0.8 - Major Bow Mechanics Improvement
notes.content:
We've been working on the improvement of bow mechanics for quite a long time. 
Finally, we can show it to you. 
Here is the list of changes we made to accomplish that:
[olist]
[*] [b]Vertical Offset[/b] introduced - the further you stretch the bow, the closer the arrow gets to your's eye (In the vertical axis)  This allows for the best aiming results. Besides that, it makes the arrow not fly above the orcs. This is represented by "Improve Offset" option in settings
[*] [b]Increase Horizontal Offset[/b] - now the arrow goes straight forward, while before it went to the left
[*]  [b]New Horizontal Offset calculation[/b] - before the rotation of the Arrow hand controller have a big impact on the direction of the arrow. We have change the way of calculation so now the aiming should be much more consistent
[*] [b]Fix arrow spawning position[/b] - Before, upon the release of the arrow it's position was slightly changed especially when holding bow horizontally. Now it's fixed.
[*] [b]Scale the bow model[b] for easier aiming.
[*] Make arrow thicker for better visibility.
[*] [b]Increase velocity of arrow [/b]
[*] Improve release arrow sound
[/olist]

Here is a capture of a very professional benchmark: :) 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PQG4hN3DKTg


We will appreciate any comments about new mechanics. Thanks for support.


Other Fixes: 
[olist]
[*]Caching the Achievement Statistics for better performance.
[*]Slightly increased difficulty on SinglePlayer (the last update messed it up)
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.0.7 - The new difficulty system
notes.content:
This is the first attempt to create the new difficulty system (which was requested by the community) 

The two requirements of the new system are: 
[b]1. The difficulty is not too steep even for the only one player.[/b] 
Until now the difficulty wasn't scaled accordingly to the player number.
It was too hard to progress through waves if there was only one player in the game.
The new formula significantly decreases the difficulty for 1 or 2  or 3 players playing.
The difficulty for 4 players stays as it was before.

[b]2. The realism of the game is still preserved:[/b]
When the player joins, your chances against the horde increase.
When the player leaves you will have more trouble in the next wave than before.
If you want to reach the highest wave it's wise to gather 3 skilled archers at your side than to try defense on your own. :)
